posts.body:
Relive the era of flip phones, MySpace, and boybands! Smitty's is hosting a Y2K Rewind party where you can grab your friends, dress in your best Y2K outfits and party like it's 2000 again!

FRIDAY, AUGUST 7TH
7PM-11PM
SMITTY'S GAMELAB

👍 Free Event
💃 Dance Floor
🏆 Prizes
🧠 Y2K Trivia
😍 Costume Contest
🍹 Themed Cocktails

Don't miss this awesome nostalgic trip back in time! Only at Smitty's GameLab locations (Sanford, ME, Topsham, ME, and Tilton, NH).
